---
title: Webhooks
description: Get notified when submissions arrive.
---

import { Tabs, TabItem } from '@astrojs/starlight/components';

A webhook is an HTTPS endpoint Fieldkit calls when something happens in your workspace.

## Events

| Event | Sent when |
| ----- | --------- |
| `submission.created` | A submission finishes uploading, attachments included |
| `submission.revised` | A later submission revises an earlier one |
| `device.asleep` | A device passes its auto-sleep interval |
| `device.retired` | A device is retired, by hand or automatically |
| `export.completed` | An export is ready to download |

## Registering an Endpoint

<Tabs syncKey="language">
<TabItem label="Python" icon="seti:python">
```python
hook = fk.webhooks.create(
    url="https://example.org/fieldkit",
    events=["submission.created", "device.retired"],
)
print(hook.secret)
```
</TabItem>
<TabItem label="TypeScript" icon="seti:typescript">
```typescript
const hook = await fk.webhooks.create({
  url: 'https://example.org/fieldkit',
  events: ['submission.created', 'device.retired'],
})
console.log(hook.secret)
```
</TabItem>
</Tabs>

## Verifying Signatures

Every delivery carries a `Fieldkit-Signature` header: an HMAC-SHA256 of the raw body under the webhook's secret.

```python
from fieldkit.webhooks import verify

verify(body=request.body, signature=request.headers["Fieldkit-Signature"], secret=SECRET)
```

:::caution
Verify against the **raw** body. A framework that parses JSON and re-serialises it produces different bytes, and every signature fails.
:::

## Retries

A delivery that does not get a `2xx` within 10 seconds is retried with backoff for up to 24 hours. For `device.asleep` see [Device Management](/docs/device-management#auto-sleep-interval).
